nom: TONYMOLY Mask Melt Collagen + Peptide Overnight Hydrogel Mask

avis.texte: I wanted to love this but it kept slipping off of my face. It didnt even last five minutes! The mask was also massive and needed to be trimmer quite a bit. I wouldnt recommend it.

I bought this mask for my flight and when I opened it, it was ripped in multiple places. I still put it on and the bottom half started sliding off my face. I had it on for about two minutes and an hour later my face is still sticky.

Used this face mask for the good 3 hours it recommends, you can use it overnight but since I toss and turn in my sleep I didn't want to risk waking up with it off my face. When I woke up today I noticed that it left my face feeling super hot and red. I have sensitive skin and a ton of allergies but I don't have problems with the other 15-30 minute face masks from this brand. Almost 24 hours in and the redness and heat hasn't cleared. I wouldn't recommend this especially if you have an important event the next day. For now I'm not using any makeup or doing a skin care routine until it clears up because I don't want to risk irritating my skin even more. On the upside the face mask does work even with these issues, it left my skin feeling hydrated but I would still be cautious buying it.
My mask was broken up so bad I couldn't put it on my face. Which was really sad because I was very exited to try it out for the first time.

Never been a huge fan of Tony Moly but i bought a few of these masks to see if they compared to the more expensive brands and was blown away. Im 28 and starting to see my first signs of skin aging. This mask made my skin look the best it has in years after wearing it for a few hours. I now use one a week and the price point is such a bonus. I never write reviews but im so in love with how plump, hydrated, and glowy my skin looks! The pink collagen mask is my favorite. I also have oretty sensitive skin and this hasnt irritated me at all. I recommend finishing up with the la roche posay cica blast b3 barrier repair cream. Thank me later!

avis.titre: I wholeheartedly recommend this to EVERYONE over 40
avis.texte: Left it on for 2 hrs only. My skin felt hydrated, refreshed, soft and - most importantly for Rosacea sufferers, no redness, no irritation, or itching, and the next day no bumps! If i had time to use this every day i would! i use them once a week now!

avis.titre: I would not buy this product!
avis.texte: Beware! I used the mask and broke out in a red and hot rash the next day. I only left mask on for 3 hours instead of overnight and it was terrible!

I am mask obsessed. These are my first choice, always! I love them so much and am so sad when one color is out. I usually buy one of each color. They stay on good and leave my skin feeling and looking amazing the next day! 100% best mask out.

gifted by tonymoly these are a great affordable masking experience I really liked how firm and bright it left my skin. I definitely will be trying the other ones because I was very impressed by these performance

On the plus side, this is a very hydrating mask. It is literally a mask that sicks on to your face and it stays in place quite well.You don't have to lay down to keep it from falling off. It applied easily and adheres well. What I didn't care for are the instructions to wear this for 3+ hours. You can wear it overnight, but that would require you to pretty much lay on your back which doesn't work for me. However, I did wear it for the 3 hours and while it appears to have nicely absorbed into my skin, there are so many other hydrating mask options that I wouldn't buy this again, but find something a bit more practical and not such a commitment!

I honestly loved this gifted by Tony Moly mask! It has that signature Tony Moly spa-like feel, but what really stood out was how soft and hydrated my skin felt afterward. The "melt" texture is super satisfying, it adheres nicely and doesn't slip around like some sheet masks. When I removed it, my skin looked fresh and dewy without feeling sticky or heavy. It gave me that healthy glow that makes you want to skip foundation the next morning. Perfect for when your skin needs a reset after a long week or a night out. I have sensitive skin with some dark spots, and it didn't irritate or cause redness at all. Highly recommend if you're looking for an affordable, quick glow-up mask that actually delivers.

avis.titre: Definitely a repurchase. A very good overnight mask.
avis.texte: I absolutely loved this mask! It fit snugly without slipping and felt so cooling on my skin. After just a few hours, my face looked plumper, smoother, and had a nice glow as if I had a mini facial. I also really like how it is super easy to use overnight. Definitely a great option for tired skin. This was gifted by Tony Moly.

I did enjoy this mask. I couldn't sleep with it on because I'm a stomach sleeper but I left it on for several hours and it really felt like it hydrated my skin but I didn't really notice any firming. Overall it was a nice mask and it would be great to keep on overnight and wake up to plump and hydrated skin. Gifted by tonymoly

Great product! Loved how it made my skin feel, definitely recommend! Very aesthetic as well! Great for get ready with me videos or reset videos! I received this product complimentary from in exchange for the post but will definitely be purchasing!

avis.titre: Love how hydrated my skin felt!
avis.texte: I love this mask so much! It left my skin feeling so soft and hydrated. I also love how the mask didn't slip and slide anywhere like a lot of other masks I've tried do. It's so cute and pink and aesthetic too. #giftedbytonymoly

Good face sheet mask that feels cooling on your face and also leaves my skin feeling moisturized and glowing! Really affordable brand too so it's worth the money and trying different ones. Gifted by tony moly

This mask makes my skin look and feel so smooth and moisturized! I love how it fits my face well and it has a cooling sensation when i put it on. My skin looks so nice after i use it! Gifted by tonymoly

A peptide mask is a great way to give your skin a treat: hydration, bounce, and improved resilience without as much risk of irritation. It won't be a miracle fix for deep wrinkles or dramatic lifting, but it can absolutely contribute to smoother, firmer, more radiant skin — especially when used regularly, and as part of a full skincare routine (cleanser, moisturizer, sunscreen, etc.) this gifted by Tony moly

The TONYMOLY Melt & Glow Mask leaves my skin soft, dewy, and radiant! It melts beautifully into the skin, giving an instant boost of hydration and glow. Perfect for a quick self-care moment before bed or events. My skin feels refreshed and plump after use! Gifted by tonymoly

This is one my favorite masks. It hugged my face nicely and you can feel the ingredients firming and hydrating my skin. Once it was off, I can see how it helped brighten my skin as well. Korean skincare is my favorite, I would recommend! Gifted by tonymoly.

Gifted by TONYMOLY. The new Mask, Melt & Glow was easy to apply. It adheres to the skin well. I wore it overnight and did not experience any discomfort. After removal, I skin looks clear and radiant. It feels hydrated and bouncy. This is a great mask to pamper the skin at least once a week!

Wow this is so good I used this on the plane and it was amazing! My face felt so refreshed and I can tell it really hydrated my skin. I left it on for a while and my skin was glowing! So good for the price! Gifted by tonymoly

avis.titre: The perfect mask for dry skin!
avis.texte: So I've been using TONYMOLY skincare for a while now and I love their products, so I couldn't wait to try their overnight mask and it did not disappoint! I was gifted by TONYMOLY to try their Mask Melt Hydrogel Mask and it was such a great experience. Firstly, I loved how soothing and cool the mask felt on my skin. Almost instantly, my skin felt calm and relaxed. My skin also felt incredibly hydrated and moisturized. This is definitely a great mask for people with dry skin like myself as it provides so much moisture to the skin. I absolute loved how great my skin looked after applying the mask. My skin looked vibrant and youthful, and my pores were virtually non existent. Overall, the Mask Melt Overnight Hydrogel Mask is now a new favorite mask for me and I couldn't recommend it more!

I loved getting to use this mask and I have to get more! This mask felt amazing on my skin and made me feel like I was at a spa! I also like that the mask comes in two pieces and it better fit onto my face Complimentary from tonymoly

Complimentary from tonymoly to share my honest review. This mask feels really nice on my skin really rich. My skin feel great in the morning . I love it and I want to try the other ones too. Def recommend

The best mask ever!! I love TonyMoly as a brand and I feel they make great accessible skincare. This mask left my skin incredibly glowy as I do tend to have dry skin. k-beauty is incredible and I can't wait to try more masks from this line. I also love the material of these masks, it feels so nice on the skin. I love that it's pink and comes in two parts! Complimentary from TonyMoly.

The Tony Moly Melt and Glow Mask is fun to use and leaves skin feeling fresh, smooth, and radiant. It melts into the skin beautifully and gives a healthy glow without any stickiness. Love it, makes my skin look so fresh. It was gifted to me by Tony moly

So I received this product for free and let me tell you my face NEEDED IT! It's so cooling and feels so good on the face I left it on for the 3 hours because I cant sleep with stuff on my face but it was so lightweight I probably could have! It was 10/10 mask, my face felt so hydrated and firm afterwards. This will definitely become a staple in my routine. Complimentary from tonymoly!
